cards.prompt: What does the GIL mean for CPU-bound threads in CPython?
cards.answer: Only one thread runs Python bytecode at a time, so CPU-heavy threads don't speed up. Use `multiprocessing` (or native code) for parallel CPU work; threads still help while waiting on I/O.
